{{Quote|Not for the faint of heart! This zesty slider features a patty topped with mouthwatering Zeltron pop-peppers, pink lettuce, magenta onions and spicy "pleasure planet" sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, regarding the Zeltros slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''"Pleasure planet" sauce''' was used by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The spicy [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] was an ingredient in the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant's]] [[Zeltros slider]], a [[Slider|dish]] inspired by Jettster's travel around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and specifically<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> the planet [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] which was also known pleasure and recreation.<ref name="Pleasure Planet">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040105zeltros|text=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet|int=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Pleasure planet" sauce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
